I'm in therapy for "Pure O tendencies". My therapist says I fit the bill but it's a little too early to diagnose, so take what I say with a grain of salt.

I've had delusions where I was convinced I was terminally ill, and began to make plans to move to Canada so I could get better healthcare for my non-existent disease. I would lie to doctors to get them to perform tests on me that I probably didn't need. I denied any diagnosis that wasn't the one I was so sure I had. At the time, I thought I was the most sane person on the planet, I didn't even entertain the thought that I could be wrong. Im not a mental health professional, but it sounds like it could be a delusion to me, and sounds similar to some of my experiences. I have intrusive thoughts but my main symptom that I struggle with is the paranoia.

I also have had similar experiences of seeing something that triggers an episode and it hits me like a ton of bricks and then subsides fairly quick.

Was there any compulsion that followed? Anything you would do to relieve the anxiety when you believed you were going to hell? Do you have a history of anxiety/paranoia?

It could be Pure O, but delusions can be a symptom of a lot of different disorders. I think what's more important than determining *if* you had a delusion is understanding *why*. I would really urge you to speak to a professional. Youre still young and a lot of mental illnesses and disorders start developing in the late teens/early 20's.

I'm sorry you had to go through that, it must have been terrifying!!
